title: Asset class module
description: One asset class. Adding a class means adding a folder and this file — nothing central is edited, so a new tab cannot half-exist.

id.description: Also the folder name. A mismatch is rejected, so the two cannot drift.

horizon_days.description: How long this class takes to give feedback. Housing is slow, FX is fast; scores are never compared across classes because of it.

seers.description: Fewer than two makes the class incomplete: a single seer has nothing to be wrong against, so its track record means nothing.
